svg.title: R10 Palatine Lincoln arcade shelf: one-bay exploded assembly and first-wall topology
svg.desc: Qualification-only engineering diagram. The main view shows one 254 millimeter bay with two supports, two cassette halves, three independent splice logs, three individual log retainers, and two bay-local support retainers. An inset shows seven supports and six bays across the 61.25 inch first wall, with a cable receiver only at the far-left outer bookend and a non-released terminal placeholder at the far right. Rated capacity is zero pounds and the diagram is not a drilling schedule.
svg.text: QUALIFICATION ARTICLE ONLY • RATED CAPACITY: 0 LB / 0 KG • NOT A DRILLING OR INSTALLATION DIAGRAM
